rows.en: <operator(10010,1)><speed(2)>Still, that <color(5)>Berkt<ce()> guy... What's he even scheming?
<operator(17030,1)><speed(2)>A doomsayer, maybe? The type who can't wait to smash the world to pieces.
<operator(17040,1)><speed(2)>Our world is overflowing with despair. It's no wonder someone would think that way.
<operator(23030,1)><speed(2)>I know a guy like that too... What a pain. He can go and destroy himself alone.
<operator(23010,1)><speed(2)>Yeah! I've only been alive for fourteen years! I don't want the world to end!
<operator(23020,1)><speed(2)>So it doesn't come to that... we have to do something!
<operator(1020,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Barrel<ce()>, you've got no fire in you. This is an important moment, so get your head in the game.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>...I get it.
<operator(1020,1)><speed(2)>You clearly don't, that's why I'm telling you. Snap out of it!
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>Y-yes...!
<operator(1020,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Faye<ce()>, you spoil him too much, too. If you're his partner, you need to tell him properly.
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>S-sorry...
<operator(23040,1)><speed(2)>W-wow, that's pretty harsh.
<operator(1020,1)><speed(2)>It's necessary if we're going to keep fighting. I don't want my comrades to die.
<operator(21030,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Gainer<ce()>. We've got no room to spare anymore, so buckle down and work, okay?
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)>I know. I know, but... Can I really pull off what <color(4)>Amuro<ce()> does?
<operator(21030,1)><speed(2)>Have more confidence, if you're the King!
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)>A-alright! I'll do my best!
<operator(16040,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Gainer<ce()>! That's the spirit! <color(4)>Asap<ce()>, you do your best too, all right?
<operator(16010,1)><speed(2)>Y-yeah.
<operator(21020,2)><speed(2)>Sheesh. The boys are whipped, huh?
<operator(17030,2)><speed(2)>Isn't that its own kind of happiness?
<operator(17040,1)><speed(2)>Be careful, <color(4)>Gain<ce()>, <color(4)>Holland<ce()>. I've seen the data on <color(5)>Neo Zeon<ce()>'s forces -- impressive, for a private army.
<operator(17040,1)><speed(2)>Though not enough to go head-to-head with the <color(4)>Federation<ce()>...
rows.notes: Bare 'renpou' rendered 'Federation' (Earth Federation, per glossary.json org.earth_federation), distinct from the locked 'New Federation'.

rows.en: <operator(21020,1)><speed(2)>And yet they're trying anyway, so their commander must be very capable.
<operator(23030,1)><speed(2)>Hmph... Nobody who takes command in the military is any good.
<operator(19060,1)><speed(2)>The moon, huh...
<operator(19020,1)><speed(2)>What's up, old man? Getting all serious all of a sudden.
<operator(19030,1)><speed(2)>He's remembering. The old days, fighting on the moon.
<operator(19060,1)><speed(2)>If <color(4)>Hayato<ce()> and I got back in a Getter, <color(4)>Kei<ce()> and the others wouldn't have to risk their necks...
<operator(19020,1)><speed(2)>No need to worry, old man! We're invincible!
<operator(19060,1)><speed(2)>That's right... Go on and raise all the hell you want!
<operator(14030,1)><speed(2)>A fleet this size... Guess the enemy means business.
<operator(6011,1)><speed(2)>There's only one thing to do. ...If this becomes an obstacle... I eliminate it.
<operator(14030,1)><speed(2)>I'm counting on that straight shooting of yours.
<operator(6011,1)><speed(2)>Mission understood.
rows.notes: Matches established corpus rendering of 'ninmu ryoukai' (batch_03629).

rows.en: <operator(12051,1)><speed(2)>With the <color(4)>Nadesico<ce()> gone, I'll cover for it all on my own!
<operator(12061,1)><speed(2)>Overconfidence is how you get hurt, you know?
<operator(12071,1)><speed(2)>Overconfidence... how much is that, numerically? Maybe ten to the third power?
rows.notes: Source sings a playful jingle with fullwidth tildes and musical notes; rendered as plain spoken lines (ASCII rule).

rows.en: <operator(12051,2)><speed(2)>Shut it! Just watch and see! I'll make you realize what I can really do!

uncertainties.issue: Bare 'renpou' (no 'shin'/new) rendered 'Federation': Earth Federation per glossary.json org.earth_federation, distinct from the locked 'New Federation'. Matches reviewed scene 4004463's use of a bare 'Federation'.
Izumi's sung line (fullwidth tildes, musical notes around a numeric joke) rendered as plain ASCII speech; the singing/jingle quality is lost.

glyph_fixes.before: The type who just can't wait to smash the world to pieces.
glyph_fixes.after: The type who can't wait to smash the world to pieces.
glyph_fixes.reason: font has no native-size lowercase j/q; dropped 'just' rather than keep the letter j.

glyph_fixes.before: so their commander must be quite capable.
glyph_fixes.after: so their commander must be very capable.

checked_decisions: 0/20 'doomsayer' for 'hametsu shugisha': the immediately following clause ('the type who can't wait to smash the world to pieces') fully disambiguates the sense (one who wants destruction, not one who merely predicts it); source meaning preserved. Accepted, not a meaning fix.
1/65 'shiri ni shikareru' (henpecked) idiom rendered 'whipped': meaning preserved, tone matches Gain's teasing register. Accepted.
1/100 bare 'renpou' rendered bare 'Federation': per orchestrator ruling this is correct (distinct from locked 'New Federation'). Accepted, matches ruling.

1/221 Izumi's sung numeric joke rendered as plain ASCII speech: required by the no-non-ASCII/no-fullwidth-glyph constraint; content (the '10^3' joke) is preserved even though the sung delivery is lost. Accepted as an unavoidable trade-off, not a defect.
remaining_uncertainties: 1/221: the jingle/singing quality of Izumi's line cannot be represented in plain ASCII text; flagged for awareness only, no fix available within constraints.
